Search the PDB for a homologous experimental structure.

quality.interpretation: pLDDT bands: >=90 very high, 70-90 confident, 50-70 low, <50 very low (AlphaFold DB convention).
quality.b_factor_caveat: B-factors were all between 0 and 1, which is how the ESMFold API writes pLDDT. They have been rescaled by 100, so the figures below are on the usual 0-100 scale. Without that rescaling an 84 pLDDT model reads as 0.84 and would be reported as very low confidence.
